THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The case file

THE SCENE

You are in film class. Your team is making a one minute film. It will show what a lost film looked like. You need four clues for your case file. Four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

This case is about Oscar Micheaux, a Black filmmaker. In 1919 he made his first film. It had no sound, so musicians played in the theater. No copy of the film exists today.
